spanish: E hicieron dos engastes de oro y dos anillos de oro, y dieron los dos anillos sobre los dos extremos del joshen.

findings.issue: הַחֹשֶׁן is a common noun (H2833, masculine singular), rendered as the untranslated transliteration joshen instead of a Spanish common noun.

notes: The two make/give clauses, duals, gold, rings, and ends otherwise match the packet.
